# STEMPACT ACADEMY
> STEM, Digital Skills, Technical & Vocational Education, Innovation, and Entrepreneurship Academy based in Ile-Ife, Osun State, Nigeria. "STEM Skills for Real-World Impact."

STEMPACT ACADEMY is an accredited institution delivering industry-aligned technology, engineering, creative media, and entrepreneurship education across Nigeria and globally via hybrid, physical, and virtual classrooms.

## Core Summary
- **Organization**: STEMPACT ACADEMY
- **Headquarters / Main Hub**: STEMPACT Innovation Hub, Fajuyi Road, Ile-Ife, Osun State, Nigeria
- **Learning Center Network**: Physical campuses, satellite hubs (Ile-Ife, Osun State), and a 100% Virtual Global Campus.
- **Delivery Formats**: Onsite practical laboratory sessions, hybrid cohorts, and interactive online bootcamps.
- **Accreditation & Outcomes**: Dual certification (practical competence & project defense), industry portfolio review, and placement readiness.
- **Website**: https://stempactacademy.com
- **Admissions Application**: https://stempactacademy.com/apply
- **Certificate Verification**: https://stempactacademy.com/verify-certificate

## Academic Structure & Schools
STEMPACT ACADEMY operates 4 core schools and over 11 specialized career track programs:

### 1. School of Computing & Software Engineering
- **Full-Stack Web & Cloud Software Engineering**: TypeScript, React, Node.js, Python, PostgreSQL, Docker, Cloud Architecture.
- **Mobile Application Development**: React Native, Flutter, iOS & Android application deployment.
- **Cybersecurity & Ethical Hacking**: Network security, vulnerability assessment, defense operations.

### 2. School of Artificial Intelligence & Data Science
- **Data Science & Analytics**: Python, Pandas, SQL, PowerBI, statistical modeling.
- **Applied Artificial Intelligence & Machine Learning**: Deep learning, Computer Vision, Natural Language Processing, LLM fine-tuning.

### 3. School of Hardware, Robotics & Emerging Technologies
- **IoT & Embedded Systems**: Arduino, ESP32, Raspberry Pi, sensor integration.
- **Robotics & Automation**: Mechanical design, firmware programming, autonomous navigation.
- **Renewable Solar Energy & Electrical Technology**: Solar PV installation, inverter sizing, power auditing.

### 4. School of Creative Media & Digital Innovation
- **UI/UX Product Design**: User research, Figma, design systems, rapid prototyping.
- **Digital Marketing & Growth Strategy**: SEO, content strategy, brand storytelling, analytics.
- **Tech Entrepreneurship & Product Incubation**: Startup validation, pitch deck mastery, business finance.

## Progressive Academic Levels
STEMPACT ACADEMY utilizes a structured 4-tier academic progression model:
1. **Level 1 — Foundation**: Fundamental syntax, digital literacy, foundational labs, and core principles.
2. **Level 2 — Intermediate**: Applied frameworks, database design, hardware interfacing, and team sprints.
3. **Level 3 — Advanced**: Enterprise architecture, distributed systems, capstone project development.
4. **Level 4 — Mastery / Specialist**: Industrial defense, venture building, specialist research, and mentorship.

## Admissions & Placement Benchmarks
- Prospective students submit an application via the online Admissions Wizard (`/apply`).
- An AI-powered assessment benchmark and Academic Placement Board evaluate applicant background to recommend optimal level placement (Level 1 Foundation through Level 4 Mastery).
- Flexible payment models: Full tuition, phased milestone payments, and corporate/government sponsorships.
